candidate_conditioned_population: fully canonical-gold-representable in frozen Top-100, predeclared source IDs
canonicalization: scenario and choice-list order invariant; duplicate alternatives removed within sets

metrics.CARDINALITY_EXACT_ACCURACY: all applicable canonical structural cardinalities exact after matching
metrics.COMPLETE_SCENARIO_SUCCESS: mean complex-source scenario satisfaction indicator under permutation-invariant scenario/slot matching
metrics.EXACT_CANONICAL_STRUCTURE_MATCH: mean exact canonical semantic signature indicator
metrics.FLAT_SET: source-macro and micro set precision/recall/F1 with both-empty=1
metrics.NO_MAP: TP/FP/FN/TN, precision/recall/F1, false forced-map and false-NO_MAP rates
metrics.RETRIEVAL_VS_DECODER: nonexact prediction classified by frozen full-gold Top-100 representability
metrics.STRUCTURE_VALIDITY_RATE: valid candidate-contained canonical outputs divided by all predictions
